text: We evaluated adaptive label smoothing weighted by per-sample loss drop on the SciQ testbed, running the configuration across 5 seeds (num_seeds = 5). The measured performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.51. Because no baseline PGR was supplied with this experiment, this number should be read as a standalone measurement rather than as evidence that the method improves on any alternative; we make no comparative claim here. The metrics also omit a standard error or per-seed spread, so the dispersion of PGR across the 5 runs cannot be assessed from the data provided, and we cannot judge how much of the reported value reflects seed-level variability. Follow-up work should record a matched baseline under the same testbed and seed set, together with per-seed PGR values and an associated standard error, before any statement about the method's relative effectiveness is made. As it stands, the finding is a single aggregate point estimate of 0.51 on SciQ.
